title: Admin UI + API: view error budget status by tier/service and record TTL overrides
author: Benji Okafor
description:
Motivation: Oncall + release tooling needs a single place to (a) inspect current error budget status by tier/service/region and (b) issue time-bounded overrides with an audit trail (e.g. unblock a security hotfix when budget is exhausted, or temporarily disable gating during a metric incident). This PR adds an internal admin API and a minimal admin Console view under /admin.

What’s included (MVP): (1) Internal API endpoints for querying computed budget status (by tier/service, optional region/route/model filters) backed by the existing budget computation store from ENG-2421. (2) Override create/revoke with TTL: records reason, requested_by, approved_by, scope, and expires_at; overrides are enforced by the existing budget-check evaluation path (release gates + policy engine hook). (3) Internal admin UI page with table + detail drawer to view current status and manage overrides; includes search + filters (tier/service/region) and links to SLO dashboards/runbooks.

Non-goals: customer-facing budget UI, per-customer Dedicated views (we keep dedicated scope limited to tier=dedicated + service-level status for now), and any changes to SLO definitions/targets.

Security/RBAC: endpoints are behind internal auth + RBAC permissions (reliability:error_budgets:read, reliability:error_budget_overrides:write). All override writes emit an audit event and require an explicit reason string.

Rollout: internal-only; no routing/public API changes. We’ll dogfood with platform-oncall + dedicated-oncall for two weeks before broadening access.

Screenshots: included in the PR discussion (admin page list view + override modal).
commits: control-plane: add ErrorBudgetAdminService and storage adapter for override records
policy: plumb override evaluation into budget-check decision path
console-admin: add /admin/reliability/error-budgets page + override create/revoke flows
tests: unit tests for TTL expiry + scope matching; API auth/RBAC tests
docs: internal README for operations + example curl calls
notable_snippets: Internal API (create override): POST /internal/error-budgets/overrides {"tier":"hosted","service":"api-gateway","mode":"ALLOW_DEPLOY","expires_in_minutes":120,"reason":"Security hotfix; burn caused by known metric misclassification"}
Override matching: exact match on tier + service; optional region scoping; route/model scoping intentionally not supported in MVP to avoid surprise cardinality and complex UX
review_conversation:
Ethan Park (review): Love the direction. Two asks: (1) can we ensure override evaluation is only consulted in the final decision path (budget-check) and not leaked into general request routing? and (2) please confirm we’re not adding any new high-cardinality labels to the budget store queries.

Benji Okafor (author): Yep. Override consult is only in the deploy gate / budget-check policy hook. No runtime routing changes. For (2) the status query API only supports tier/service (+ optional region) and reads pre-aggregated rows from budget_status_hourly; no per-route/model query parameters wired.

Rafael Mendes (review): TTL expiry handling: right now expiry is checked on read. We should also have a background cleanup so stale overrides don’t confuse audits. Also please add a runbook note for what to do if the admin UI is down during an incident.

Benji Okafor (author): Added a lightweight hourly cleanup job (soft-delete + audit event error_budget_override.expired). Also added an internal doc snippet with direct curl usage for the API, so UI isn’t required.

Aisha Bello (review): Can we standardize the status enums with the burn-rate policy language? Suggest: OK / AT_RISK / EXHAUSTED (and include remaining_percent + burn_rate_1h + burn_rate_6h). Also add a link-out to the Confluence policy page.

Benji Okafor (author): Updated response schema + UI labels to match. Included burn rates + remaining budget. Added policy link + runbook link placeholders.

Jordan Lee (review): RBAC and audit look good. One nit: the override scope should be explicit in the audit payload (tier, service, region?) and the UI should display approved_by. Also please ensure we validate expires_in_minutes bounds.

Benji Okafor (author): Done. Added validation: 5 <= expires_in_minutes <= 1440, and require approved_by for write requests (pulled from auth context).

Connor O'Brien (review): Process: we should require a ticket/incident reference for overrides once we move to soft/hard block. For now, can we at least add an optional reference field so we don’t have to migrate later?

Benji Okafor (author): Added optional reference field (freeform string) and surfaced it in the UI. Not required yet.

Sahana Iyer (review): From the CI gate side, I’d like an API field that indicates “override active” so the gate can print a clear explanation. Is that included?

Benji Okafor (author): Yes: status response includes override_active=true + override_expires_at.

Approvals: Ethan Park approved; Rafael Mendes approved; Aisha Bello approved; Jordan Lee approved; Connor O'Brien approved; Sahana Iyer approved.
testing_notes: Manual: validated admin page renders for platform-oncall role, filters by tier/service/region, and shows correct status/burn metrics for api-gateway hosted in us-east-1. Created override with 30m TTL, confirmed budget-check decision flips from EXHAUSTED->OVERRIDDEN (UI shows banner + expiry). Verified override expires automatically and emits audit event. Automated: added unit tests for scope matching and TTL bounds; integration tests for RBAC (read vs write) and audit emission.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge behind internal-only routing (/admin + /internal/*) and RBAC perms default deny. 2) Grant read access to #eng-sre + platform-oncall + dedicated-oncall. 3) Grant write access only to SRE managers + release governance (Connor O'Brien) for first 2 weeks. 4) Collect feedback, then expand to service owners participating in enforcement pilot (ENG-2427).
follow_ups: Add per-route/model scope once SLI cardinality controls are finalized (ENG-2424) and UX is agreed with Console team
Wire override reference to Linear/Jira link auto-formatting in UI (optional)
Add “export as JSON” button for incident channels and incident-bot integration
